_comment: SFT corpus generation. Boros Aggro mirror, chosen against a measured defect rather than by taste: the pilot passes 38% of decisions where it holds a playable card, and combat is 4.4% of the corpus. That is a basic-action failure, so the deck is picked to maximise the scarce decision types -- low curve, creature-dense, attacks every turn. Mirror removes matchup variance, so a behaviour change is attributable to the policy. Boros Aggro is also one of only 9 of the 26 Standard registry decks with a legal 60-card maindeck; Mono-Red Aggro was the more natural aggro pick and is 53 cards.
